_what: Committed reference values for the test suite. These are measurements from the validated production runs; the tests check that this build still reproduces them. Nothing here is fitted.

three_gamma._tau_3gamma_source: Vallery, Zitzewitz & Gidley, Phys. Rev. Lett. 90, 203402 (2003)
three_gamma._note: A 1.5741 % three-photon share implies a mean o-Ps tau_eff of 0.015741 * 142.05 = 2.236 ns across the simulated population.

oxygen_quenching._note: Same free-volume radius, oxygen tension 0 vs 100 mmHg. Computed from the model constants, not measured: the whole physiological range moves the lifetime by 9.4 ps, which is far below what a delayed-coincidence measurement can resolve. kappa is the materials database version 8 value (plasma O2 solubility); through version 7 it was 2.45e-05, which gives 1.9125 ns and 9.0 ps. The test requires the analysis module, this file and materials/pli_materials.json to agree.

null_transport_vs_source._note: In a single-material phantom the lifetime taken from the annihilation material and from the emission material must agree; this is the null arm. Measured difference 0.07 %.

boundary_case._note: The atlas database declares air with I3 = 0, so no positronium forms there. Every declared tau_eff must be finite and positive.

pedestal_law._note: Over-subtracting a uniform pedestal equal to 10 % of the signal biases a 1.8 ns lifetime low by 11.77 %.

fixed_seed_quickstart._note: The quickstart macro with its seed fixed at 12345. Reproduced exactly by a build with the same Geant4 and compiler.
